description: The evidence behind one depositor position’s result, as JSON to keep: the opening balance read at a block before the first flow we read, every deposit and withdrawal with its transaction and log, the address’s share events up to the head block (withdrawals through a router labelled routed_withdraw and counted once for the user), the balance at the head block and the integer equation opening + minted − burned (+ transfers) = shares now, with a proof id. "Reconciled for the stated period" means that equation closes; it is not an independent audit. FREE.

slug.description: The vault slug (or contract address) the position is in; depositor_positions lists them.

name: position_evidence

basisState.description: reconciled_for_scope, estimated, unknown_opening, incomplete_flow_history, transfer_basis_unknown, price_missing, stale, revoked, position_not_read, …

means.description: What reconciled means and does not.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

opening.description: Block, time, raw shares and assets of the opening read.

reconciliation.description: The integer equation and whether it closes.

shareEvents.description: The address’s share events between opening and head.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: One position’s evidence
